question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing striker, and Claire is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) striker
(C) right winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: right back, striker, right winger
1. Bob ↔ Alice: striker, right back, right winger
2. Alice ↔ Claire: right winger, right back, striker
3. Bob ↔ Claire: right winger, striker, right back
Bob is playing striker, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
